sources.label: Wikipedia, "IRAS 04125+2902"
sources.quote: IRAS 04125+2902 is an M-type star and a T Tauri variable located in the Taurus Molecular Cloud, 160 parsecs from Earth.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Barber et al. 2024.

sources.label: Barber et al. (2024), Nature 635 574-577

sources.label: Wikipedia, "IRAS 04125+2902"
sources.quote: This young protostar has 70% of the Sun's mass, 1.45 times the Sun's radius and an effective temperature of 4,080 K. It has a very young age of three million years.
